package handlers

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	courseuc "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/course"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
)

const outlineHandlerCourseID = "8f165b10-35fc-4cbd-8a3b-e149010899ba"

type outlineHandlerRepository struct {
	outline *domain.CourseOutline
	err     error
	lang    string
}

func (r *outlineHandlerRepository) GetPublic(_ context.Context, _ string, lang string) (*domain.CourseOutline, error) {
	r.lang = lang
	return r.outline, r.err
}

func TestCourseOutline_ReturnsLightweightLocalizedHierarchy(t *testing.T) {
	repo := &outlineHandlerRepository{outline: &domain.CourseOutline{
		CourseID: outlineHandlerCourseID,
		Slug:     "programming-basics",
		Title:    "Основы программирования",
		Modules:  []domain.CourseOutlineModule{},
	}}
	handler := CourseHandler{OutlineUC: courseuc.GetCourseOutline{Outlines: repo}}
	router := chi.NewRouter()
	router.Get("/course/{courseID}/outline", handler.Outline)

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/course/"+outlineHandlerCourseID+"/outline", nil)
	req.Header.Set("Accept-Language", "ru-RU,ru;q=0.9")
	resp := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(resp, req)

	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("status = %d; body=%s", resp.Code, resp.Body.String())
	}
	if repo.lang != "ru" {
		t.Fatalf("lang = %q, want ru", repo.lang)
	}
	body := resp.Body.String()
	if !strings.Contains(body, `"title":"Основы программирования"`) || !strings.Contains(body, `"modules":[]`) {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected response: %s", body)
	}
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"description", "compose_config", "code_structure", "tests"} {
		if strings.Contains(body, forbidden) {
			t.Fatalf("response leaked %q: %s", forbidden, body)
		}
	}
}

func TestCourseOutline_HidesUnavailableCourse(t *testing.T) {
	handler := CourseHandler{OutlineUC: courseuc.GetCourseOutline{Outlines: &outlineHandlerRepository{err: domain.ErrNotFound}}}
	router := chi.NewRouter()
	router.Get("/course/{courseID}/outline", handler.Outline)

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/course/"+outlineHandlerCourseID+"/outline", nil)
	resp := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(resp, req)

	if resp.Code != http.StatusNotFound {
		t.Fatalf("status = %d, want 404; body=%s", resp.Code, resp.Body.String())
	}
}
